cohort: Neonates >= 35 weeks of gestation with a birth weight of >= 2000 g who underwent partial sepsis work-up with at least 2 consecutive CRP measurements within the first 48 hours of life, between January and December 2020.
finding: Neonatal CRP dynamics generally corresponded to their overall clinical condition but were also influenced by various non-infectious factors, including gestational age, mode of delivery, and gender.
mod_finding: Lower CRP velocity levels were associated with elective cesarean surgery.
followup_time: within the first 48 hours of life
